rationale: Keeps the need denominator separate from the canonical request denominator
Does not merge observation methods into one unsupported prevalence estimate
Reports a volunteered reason without creating a request ID
Separates farmer-reported alternative-channel service from canonical lifecycle evidence
Authorized relay preserves provenance and does not become canonical platform fulfilment
An unanswered or unasked barrier question is not inferred
Preserves open need, farmer deferral and missing follow-up as different states
Rejects linked request state without a real opaque request reference
Prevents invented canonical request IDs for no-request reports
Absence of clicks or requests is never farmer-confirmed need evidence
Prevents an unauthorized relay from entering the eligible need denominator
Requires explicit authority provenance for intermediary reports
Prevents duplicate need episodes being counted twice
Rejects cross-scope, cross-task and cross-period contamination
Prevents screened candidates and eligible episodes from silently disappearing
Prevents a contradictory barrier reason from being attributed to a linked request
Off-platform reports cannot be promoted to canonical service receipt
Unknown or missing outcomes cannot claim positive service evidence
An empty eligible cohort is not evidence of zero need or zero success
Rejects URL or personal-style identifiers in public aggregates
Rejects unversioned report fields that could bypass contract semantics
